Basic web search request with a simple query

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_search_async(client, "{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"What is Rust programming language?\"}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
